# Change-Order Proposal: CRM Connector

**To:** Client Sponsor  
**Subject:** Approval Request for Additional CRM Connector

## Requested Work
The existing signed scope covers the reporting dashboard. The client has requested an additional CRM connector, which is not included in the original fee.

The proposed change includes work to add the CRM connector.

## Price
| Item | Estimate | Proposed Change Fee |
|---|---:|---:|
| CRM connector | 40 hours at $175/hour | **$7,000 fixed fee** |

## Schedule Effect
The CRM connector is expected to add **two weeks** to the schedule following:

1. Written approval of this change order; and  
2. Receipt of client-provided sandbox credentials.

This timing is an estimate only and is not an approved calendar date.

## Dependency
Client must provide sandbox credentials before connector work can proceed.

## Approval
Connector work will not begin unless the sponsor approves this change order in writing.

Name/Title: ______________________________  
Date: ___________________________________

**Decline:** _______________________________  
Name/Title: ______________________________  
Date: ___________________________________
